# Mulled Wine

Mulled Wine is a gradient-based theme whose soft, harmonious colors are prepared for both dark and light modes. Its recorded description names subtle gradient frames and high-contrast text as what keeps the workspace readable.

![Mulled Wine screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-mulled-wine/HEAD/images/mulledwine-thumbnail.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Mulled Wine"
    author: "incantatem2"
    repo:   "incantatem2/Obsidian-mulled-wine"
    slug:   "mulled-wine"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/mulled-wine"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-mulled-wine"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-mulled-wine/HEAD/images/mulledwine-thumbnail.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply an ethereal gradient look with soft, harmonious colors crafted for both dark and light modes. Keep subtle gradient frames and high-contrast text for a calm, readable workspace."
}
```
